data.name: Per-duty-family ADS handoff. Duty name, category, support, and clearance come only from ADS CurrentDuty. FrenRider accepts that snapshot only when ADS catalog metadata is complete and its territory/CFC matches live GameMain; otherwise local duty logic stays active. The handoff delay counts only while the character remains continuously ready: logged in, present, alive, conscious, out of area transitions, and out of cutscenes. Runtime ADS ownership is authoritative even after manual Start Inside. FrenRider pauses local duty systems while handoff is pending or ADS owns the run; configured exit takeover remains available after duty completion.
data.value: Penyerahan ADS per keluarga duty. Nama, kategori, dukungan, dan izin duty hanya berasal dari ADS CurrentDuty. FrenRider menerima snapshot itu hanya jika metadata katalog ADS lengkap dan wilayah/CFC cocok dengan GameMain aktif; jika tidak, logika duty lokal tetap aktif. Penundaan penyerahan hanya dihitung saat karakter terus siap: masuk, tersedia, hidup, sadar, tidak dalam transisi area, dan tidak dalam cutscene. Kendali ADS saat berjalan tetap otoritatif bahkan setelah Start Inside manual. FrenRider menjeda sistem duty lokal saat penyerahan menunggu atau ADS mengendalikan run; pengambilalihan keluar terkonfigurasi tetap tersedia setelah duty selesai.
